name: daily-task-update-application
description: Daily Task Update application (NestJS API + React client)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w e2e
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
